text.description_html:
RK International CF-5246, Simple Cup Pull

We love this cabinet cup pull handle for its quaintness and simple design. A lot of times, plain styles are overlooked but we can't figure out why. The 3 Inch Traditional Cup Pull has a timelessness; since it does not sport a popular decor fashion, it will never go out of style. In five years, you will only see a beautiful addition to your kitchen, not an outdated piece of hardware. It is available in 5 finishes, all of them as beautiful and timeless as this elliptical cup pull is.

Specifications and Features of the RK International CF-5246 Elliptical Cup Pull with Dummy Screws:

  • Material: Brass
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Length Overall: 3-7/16"
  • Width: 1-3/8"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
